text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Japan Dirt Derby drawing near, Smart Falcon begins her summer camp training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon took on the Satsuki Sho to please her fans, despite her weakness on turf. Next, it's time to show them her true strength on the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everything Smart Falcon does is for the fans who support her. As always, she prepares to give it her all.
